# PR #173 round 2 correctness verdict

**PASS-WITH-NOTES** at `81d521fc80834ae5d4916140043765fbc65e0414`.

Reviewed the single-commit delta from `91e5a85d5e18455025157477705f4c678cb58ae5`. The checkout is clean and detached, matches the authorized remote head, and GitHub reports CLEAN.

## Closures

- **F001 closed:** the receipt now states admission accurately: `queued as a normal message (it wakes the seat when delivered); carries N held FYIs`. There is no delivery-time promise. The API documentation acknowledges the running-same-serial-key exclusion in `crates/store/src/queue.rs` and explicitly labels 381/381 deliveries within five seconds as observed history, not a promise. The peer skill uses the same corrected receipt.
- **F121 qualification closed:** `where you can set a reply mode and a time limit` accurately describes optional configuration. It no longer implies every role request has a limit; the unchanged limit parser can still return None.
- The delta changes wording and its assertions only. Committed-ID counting, failed-claim/plain fallback, admission/routing and ordinary delivery for role `--reply none` remain unchanged from the prior review.

## Proof

Exact-head CI [42437402711](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42437402711), final attempt 3, passed Rust lint, Rust tests and Node 22/24 checks. Final JUnit artifact `13600700967`, matched by creation time and test timestamp to the successful job, contains **2195 executed cases, zero failures/errors**; the runner separately reports five skipped tests.

Executed passing controls include the updated pane-bound carrier receipt, failed FYI claim/plain fallback, failing carrier preservation, role-only refusal advice, and `a_send_carrying_held_fyis_is_a_normal_delivery_never_an_fyi`, which covers normal role reply-none delivery.

An earlier attempt's artifact records a failure in unchanged `pij-tmux::adapter::capture_proves_zero_and_more_than_the_pane_contains`. The final full rerun passed; this is not a first-attempt-green claim.

## Retained nonblocking note and scope

The existing count decoder ignores malformed event JSON/ids rather than reporting an unknown count. Current typed producer shapes are covered; this unchanged limitation is not an outstanding wording repair.

No new delivery guarantee, origin-authentication claim or historical timing measurement is inferred. No local product builds/tests, mutations, dependencies, live queue probes or product edits were performed. Review evidence is source inspection plus exact-head CI; security and performance verdicts remain independently owned.
